newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - ANZ sees opportunities for growth.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - ANZ sees opportunities for growth.

text.p: Australia and New Zealand Banking Group Ltd (ANZ) said on Wednesday it saw growth opportunities for the bank in its international operations as well as investment banking, cards and funds management services.
Earlier, ANZ reported a six percent rise in net profit to A$1.12 billion for the year to September 30, 1996.
ANZ's net profits from international operations grew 17 percent during the year, compared with seven percent in Australia and a decline of five percent from New Zealand.

"Total assets grew by 13 percent, with reasonable growth across all markets. Again it was in our international operations that the strongest lending growth was achieved," chief executive officer Don Mercer said in a statement.

The bank's funds management unit achieved strong sales growth with total retail funds under management increasing by 11 percent to A$7.2 billion, but profits were down slightly from fiscal 1994/95 which had benefitted from reassessments.
ANZ said it had gained market share over the year in its Australian cards business.
At 0100 GMT (02.00 p.m.), ANZ shares were up 14 cents to A$7.65
